name: Elongated Ovoid Vase with Flaring Mouth (So-Called "Guanyin ping") and with Decoration of the Eight Trigrams, Taiji (Yin-Yang Symbols), and Waves
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；Yongzheng period, 1723-1735 or early 20th century；Blue, red, and white ware: porcelain with decoration painted in underglaze cobalt blue and underglaze copper red; with (spurious?) underglaze cobalt blue mark reading "Da Qing Yongzheng nian zhi" on the base
